# Psalm 62 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster, for-Jeduthun. A-psalm of-David.

**2** Only for-God my-soul waits-in-silence; from-Him [is] my-salvation.

**3** Only He [is] my-rock and-my-salvation, my-fortress; I-shall-not be-greatly shaken.

**4** How-long will-you-attack a-man — all-of-you murdering — like-a-leaning wall, a-tottering fence?

**5** Only from-his-height they-plan to-bring-[him]-down; they-delight in-falsehood. With-their-mouth they-bless, but-inwardly they-curse. Selah.

**6** Only for-God wait-in-silence, my-soul, for from-Him [is] my-hope.

**7** Only He [is] my-rock and-my-salvation, my-fortress; I-shall-not be-shaken.

**8** Upon God [rests] my-salvation and-my-glory; the-rock of-my-strength, my-refuge [is] in-God.

**9** Trust in-Him at-every time, O-people; pour-out before-Him your-hearts. God [is] a-refuge for-us. Selah.

**10** Only a-breath [are] the-sons of-man, a-lie [are] the-sons of-man; on-the-scales they-go-up — they [are] together lighter than-a-breath.

**11** Do-not trust in-oppression, and-in-robbery do-not become-vain; [if] wealth increases, do-not set [your] heart [upon it].

**12** Once God has-spoken; twice I-have-heard this: that power [belongs] to-God.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **62:2**: 'Only' (akh) appears six times in this psalm — the key word. Only God. Only silence. Only breath. The psalm strips away everything except the essential.

— EMET
